prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square mature painterly mythology encyclopedia artwork. ZASHIKI-WARASHI, benevolent child-shaped Iwate household guardian. One boy-shaped spirit about seven years old with ordinary human face, rounded human ears and coherent normal anatomy, neat dark bobbed hair, plain modest muted brown Japanese child kimono with simple sash. Standing at the edge of a quiet old Japanese tatami room with wooden beams, sliding shoji and a low plain wooden household chest. A subtle soft translucency at the lower kimono edge suggests apparition while the face and hands are clearly readable. Warm inviting lamplight, mysterious wholesome smile, peaceful prosperity atmosphere. No pointed ears, horns, monster teeth, claws, demon eyes, adult sexual styling, magical toys, extra figures or modern objects. Elegant detailed atmospheric brushwork, deep forest-green shadows and restrained antique-gold illumination, main head and hands contained in frame. No writing, signature, watermark, border, gore or unintended extra limbs.
